thread:
Erin: Heads-up — want to align on the discovery endpoint contract we promised customers. They've asked for an endpoint that lists supported tools, streaming support, and token limits per model/tool. sketching scope for the roadmap item.
Sam: thx. Do we mean one discovery endpoint per model-version or a global catalog? different tradeoffs.
Erin: per-model-version is ideal for correctness, but customers also want a light-weight catalog for quick lookups. thinking both: /models/:id/introspect + /catalog index.
Leo: +1. also need to advertise structured-output support (json-schema / function-calling) and whether streaming is available for that model variant.
Jordan: for launch let's capture: supported_tools[], streaming: boolean, structured_output: boolean, max_input_tokens, max_output_tokens, recommended_batch_size, and a version tag. that should cover most asks.
Alex: concern: listing "supported_tools" might leak capability surface that some enterprise customers treat as config. we should add a flag for visibility (public|private) and default to public unless customer opts out on Private deployments.
Sam: good point. Also need to decide on token limit semantics: are those hard limits (reject) or advisory? clients expect clear behavior.
Erin: proposal: two fields — hard_limit and recommended_limit. server enforces hard_limit (4000 tokens), recommended_limit used by SDKs to warn and auto-split.
Leo: implementation note: for streaming we also need to indicate if partial-streaming for structured outputs is supported (e.g., stream chunks of a JSON array) vs only text streaming. maybe streaming_modes: ["text", "json-chunks", "frame"]
Jordan: love that. also include fallback_model_ids[] to surface automatic fallback targets when capacity constrained.
Sam: can we add a small example response to lock shape? I'll sketch:

```
{
  "model_id": "redwood-xxl-v2",
  "version": "2026-03-01",
  "visibility": "public",
  "supported_tools": ["browser", "sql-runner", "calculator"],
  "streaming_modes": ["text", "json-chunks"],
  "structured_output": true,
  "token_limits": {"hard_limit": "8192", "recommended_limit": "6144"},
  "recommended_batch_size": "8",
  "fallback_model_ids": ["redwood-xxl-v1"],
  "capabilities_flags": ["function-calling", "tool-attachments"],
  "schema_version": "1"
}
```

Erin: that looks good. keep values as strings for stability (we can parse types client-side). also add a `deprecation_date` optional field for rollout transitions.
Alex: rollout plan: 1) implement introspect on hosted-only (no private) behind feature flag; 2) enable SDKs to read and adapt; 3) canary with select customers; 4) GA when we meet SLAs and have docs + console support.
Jordan: define launch criteria: docs complete, SDK support for parsing shape (py/ts), 95th pct introspect endpoint latency < 150ms under steady state, unit+e2e tests, and 3 paying customers in canary with no regressions for 7 days.
Sam: engineering asks: need a small index service to generate catalog responses and a per-model metadata store. also add caching TTL (default 60s) to reduce load.
Leo: ML ask: include quantization profile hint (e.g., "q4_0": recommended) so clients can choose cheaper variants.
Erin: add to shape: quant_profile_hints: ["q4_0", "q8_1"] and an `compat_matrix` pointer for complex tool compatibility.
capabilities-bot: new schema draft uploaded -> https://redwood-internal/drive/capability-discovery/schema-v1.json :eyes:
Jordan: action items: Erin to finalize schema doc, Sam to size index + cache, Alex to add feature-flag gating + visibility controls, Leo to provide quant profiles and fallback rules. target PRs next week.
Erin: I'll create the product PR with the launch checklist and link sample responses + rollout timeline. tagging @Sam @Alex for feasibility call tomorrow 10am.
Sam: I'll bring perf numbers and a quick prototype of the /catalog endpoint.
Alex: and I'll map private-deploy visibility + KMS implications for tool descriptors.
Jordan: great — let's keep scope tight: MVP = per-model introspect endpoint + small global catalog + SDK parsing and console view. defer compat_matrix deep-linking to follow-up.
Erin: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
